//: Story Phase 16: THE COUNTER, where the Bashfulness Branch was (crew quarters, 11-13,14). One service counter with several skins: the Grand Dispensary (customers pay Grand Tokens into the till, counter_till; they get a jar of one of Brogath's mellow wafts), the Grand Bank again (Bankworth's opening deposit at the teller's window; GRAND SASHBACK credit applications, appraised by the captain's nose; the hornets), and the Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition (the proceedings, played as scripts). The till is a story variable: it never touches the captain's purse.

grand_counter.name: THE COUNTER
grand_counter.slogan: HELLO! I'M HAPPY TO SERVE YOU
grand_counter.tokenLine: THE TILL: <y>{tokens}</> GRAND TOKENS, FROM {name}. (Not legal tender. Not yours.)
grand_counter.checkLine: A GRAND CHECK, from {name}. Stamped. Filed.
grand_counter.applicationLine: GRAND SASHBACK REWARDS: an application from {name}. The terminal wants a smell.
grand_counter.classifyRight: Into the ledger: {class}. Bankworth applauds, very quietly, with two fingers.
grand_counter.classifyWrong: bank_voice: CORRECTION: {class}. THE GRAND TRUST THANKS YOU FOR YOUR ESTIMATE.
